changes: REVIEW inventory freeze: OPEN epoch binds cutoff hashes and required lanes; saturation plus topology-critic; persistFinalizedReviewInventory writes inventory-completeness-only receipts (authorizesTest=false); certification_window_begin consumes those via consumeReviewInventoryCompletenessReceipt while REVIEW→DEV still uses consumeReviewInventoryReceipt. Incremental first-pass cap 512; topology-critic is a modular body not a five-lane REVIEW bootstrap; flow-stability discovery stubs and .proof-or-stop gitignore in concurrent incremental-context fixture.
usage: In REVIEW: review_inventory_begin, saturate required lanes plus topology critic, review_inventory_finalize. Remediation DEV consumes the wave receipt once. After final review passes and 3x2, story_advance TEST. Then review_inventory_finalize (completeness if no OPEN), certification_window_begin, done_required_validate exactly once, done_prepare --mergeMain --refreshStale, story_advance DONE. Use node packages/main/dist/cli.js in the story worktree.
expectedOutcome: Operator can freeze one REVIEW candidate, complete all required review lanes and a completeness critic until a zero-new-verified-finding saturation wave, enter one aggregated remediation DEV, run fresh final review without reducing quality assurance, then admit PRE_CERT and finish the story locally DONE.
actualTranscript: Worktree CLI: two-wave inventory (RI-050) then remediation DEV; later completeness receipts RIE-059 consumed by certification_window_begin (CW-006 ADMITTED). Five current-round review passes RP-409..413, local 3x2, TEST 112/112, done_required_validate PASS (npm test 58/58), done_prepare PASS. finding_list open blocking empty; F-134 accepted_risk naming residue. 18 bugs fixed, 0 open.
outcomeDiff: No difference versus the original snapshot: freeze, saturate, one remediation DEV, fresh final review, and local DONE are all delivered. PRE_CERT completeness is a prerequisite receipt, not TEST authority.
limitations: F-134 leftover comments still say PRE_CERT completeness receipt; gates do not treat completeness as PRE_CERT. Some follow-up items remain documented in B-3f3d-FOLLOWUP-STORIES.md and are not this story's DONE scope.
pitfalls: Do not consume completeness receipts with consumeReviewInventoryReceipt (REVIEW→DEV); certification_window_begin must use consumeReviewInventoryCompletenessReceipt. persistBlockedCertificationWindow reuses BLOCKED windows only when blockerCode and blockerDetail both match. After TEST entry do not retry done_required_validate or validate at unchanged material (unchangedSuiteExecutions). Topology-critic is modular-body, not a five-lane review_run_start bootstrap. Use the worktree CLI.
